Introducing fees on UPI transactions may adversely affect small businesses and consumer spending. Maintaining free UPI supports broader digital payments and benefits banks and payment apps. The anticipated changes could lead to higher prices for consumers and reduced earnings for merchants.

banking-economy.title: Deposit rate hikes unlikely for 3 months; RBI action to help NIMs: SBI chairman C S Setty
banking-economy.summary: State Bank of India Chairman C S Setty stated there will be no deposit rate hikes for the next three months. He cited sufficient liquidity in the system as a key reason for this prediction. Setty mentioned that credit growth is expected to sustain at 14 to 15 percent over time. He emphasized that banks need to ensure positive real interest rates for depositors amid rising inflation.

banking-economy.title: At Rs 35.9 crore, HDFC Bank's incoming boss Anup Bagchi set to be India's highest-paid bank CEO
banking-economy.summary: HDFC Bank has proposed an annual compensation package of up to Rs 35.90 crore for Anup Bagchi. This remuneration could increase to Rs 43.24 crore with performance-based stock bonuses. Bagchi's package is significantly higher compared to previous CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan's total remuneration. HDFC Bank is seeking shareholder approval for this proposed compensation and Bagchi's appointment. His leadership aims to improve retail loan growth and strengthen investor confidence.
